entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Heart, pulse, breath, throat; Anger, rage, fury, temper, wrath, disgust, contempt, resentment
entries.zh: 心脏、脉搏、呼吸、喉咙；生气、暴怒、狂怒、脾气、怒火、厌恶、蔑视、怨恨。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Cross, furious, raging; Jealous, envious, resentful; Irritating, frustrating; Bitter, vicious, poisonous; Breathless, sweating
entries.zh: 生气、盛怒、狂怒；嫉妒、羡嫉、怨恨；惹人烦、令人挫败；愤懑、恶毒、有毒般；喘不过气、出汗。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Swept, poured, simmered, smouldered; Pounded, exploded, erupted; Shook, trembled, writhed; Raced, hammered; Clenched, gripped
entries.zh: 席卷、倾泻、暗暗沸腾、闷烧；猛跳、爆发、喷发；摇晃、颤抖、扭动；急跳、猛敲；握紧、紧抓。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 怒火蒙住理智；气得眼前发红

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 怒不可遏、口沫横飞的人

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 压抑着、暗暗沸腾的怒气

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Hard lump at the back of her throat
entries.zh: 喉咙深处堵着一块硬结

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Swept through him like a tidal wave

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Poured from her like an acid
entries.zh: 愤怒像酸液一样从她身上倾泻

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Surrounded him like a foul stench

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 使他周围的空气充满敌意

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was sweating and burning with rage.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She saw his face through narrowed eyes and a fog of rage.
entries.zh: 她眯眼看着他的脸，怒气像雾一样遮住视线。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her reply fuelled his anger and he erupted like a volcano.
entries.zh: 她的回答火上浇油，使他像火山一样爆发。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The anger had returned like a hard lump at the back of her throat.
entries.zh: 怒气再次涌上来，像一块硬结堵在她喉咙深处。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His fury knew no limits – one vicious flash of temper after another.
entries.zh: 他的狂怒没有尽头，凶猛的脾气一阵接一阵地发作。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her rage swept through her like a tidal wave, surrounding her like a foul stench.
entries.zh: 愤怒像潮水般席卷她的全身，又像恶臭一样围住她。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Look, glance, stare, gaze; Snarl, grimace, leer; Expression, mask, demeanour, countenance
entries.zh: 神情、瞥视、盯视、凝视；龇牙低吼、扭曲的表情、恶意的笑；表情、面具、举止神态、面容。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Nasty, sharp, sour, fierce, hostile, livid, vengeful, volatile, malicious, murderous; Scary, threatening, monstrous, venomous, reptilian, inhuman
entries.zh: 恶劣、尖刻、阴沉、凶猛、敌意、暴怒、报复心强、暴躁、恶毒、杀气腾腾；可怕、威胁、怪物般、狠毒、爬行动物般阴冷、非人的。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Looked, glanced, gazed, stared, glared, glowered; Grinned, grimaced, leered; Twisted, clenched, jutted; Flushed, flared
entries.zh: 看、瞥、凝望、盯、怒视、阴沉地瞪；咧嘴笑、做痛苦表情、恶笑；扭曲、紧咬、伸出；泛红、张开。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 爬行动物般阴冷地龇牙低吼

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Patches of red on his cheeks

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Nostrils flared like an angry bull
entries.zh: 鼻翼像发怒的公牛一样张开

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Lips curled back in a reptilian snarl
entries.zh: 嘴唇后缩，露出阴冷的龇牙表情

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sucked his lips into his mouth

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Pressed lips tightly together into a thin line

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Lips were drawn into a sneer

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Veins pulsed furiously in her neck
entries.zh: 脖子上的血管剧烈跳动

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A burst of fury made his cheeks burn.
entries.zh: 一阵怒火使他的脸颊发烫。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The man strode towards Kitty, wearing an angry expression.
entries.zh: 那人面带怒色，大步向基蒂走来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was as if her brain was flooding with boiling blood and her face exploding in a burning heat.
entries.zh: 她仿佛脑中灌满沸腾的血，脸也烧灼得要爆开。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His reddening face was twisted into a venomous snarl and the veins in his neck pulsed furiously.
entries.zh: 他涨红的脸扭成怨毒的龇牙怒容，脖子上的血管剧烈跳动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He made a fist and scowled at Kitty with malicious little eyes and a murderous gaze.
entries.zh: 他攥紧拳头，用恶毒的小眼睛瞪着基蒂，目光里满是杀气。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Kitty saw the veins pulsing in his neck and a flash of anger burning in his eyes.
entries.zh: 基蒂看到他脖子上的血管跳动，眼里闪着燃烧的怒火。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: There were patches of red on Robert’s usually pale cheeks. Sweat glistened on his forehead and his face was thunderous.
entries.zh: 罗伯特平日苍白的两颊泛起红斑，额头汗光闪闪，脸色阴沉得像雷雨天。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her face was twisted with fury, her eyes menacing slits, her mouth a nasty sneer.
entries.zh: 她的脸因暴怒而扭曲，双眼眯成威胁的细缝，嘴上带着恶毒的冷笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face twisted like a tribal mask – his eyes bulging and livid and his lips drawn back in a hideous sneer.
entries.zh: 他的脸扭曲得像一张部族面具：双眼凸出、怒气冲冲，嘴唇后缩成可怕的讥笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His foaming lips curled back in a malicious smirk, spraying spittle as he spat out the words.
entries.zh: 他口吐白沫，嘴唇卷起一丝恶笑，吐出字句时唾沫四溅。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Nostrils flaring like an angry bull, she curled back her lip in a reptilian snarl.
entries.zh: 她像怒牛一样鼻翼翕张，嘴唇卷起，露出阴冷的龇牙怒容。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Eyes narrowed and teeth clenched, she stared at Robert with an expression of utter disbelief.
entries.zh: 她眯着眼、咬紧牙，难以置信地盯着罗伯特。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Glare, stare, scowl, squint; Raisins, slits, razors
entries.zh: 怒视、盯视、皱眉怒容、眯眼；葡萄干、细缝、剃刀。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Hard, cold, steely, staring, unblinking, demon-haunted; Cruel, fierce, hostile, piercing, withering, menacing, threatening, dangerous, malicious; Bulging, buggy, feverish
entries.zh: 冷硬、冰冷、钢铁般、直盯、一眨不眨、恶魔附体般；残酷、凶猛、敌意、锐利、令人畏缩、威吓、威胁、危险、恶毒；凸出、鼓出、狂热。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Glinted, glittered, darkened, burned, blazed; Narrowed, bulged, rolled, flickered; Drilled, blasted
entries.zh: 闪光、闪烁、变暗、燃烧、炽燃；眯起、凸出、转动、闪动；钻入、猛烈逼视。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 像葡萄干一样又小又硬

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 冰冷地直盯着人的眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 钢铁般冷硬、带威胁的眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 因愤怒眯成细缝的眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Fierce little eyes in a skull-like face
entries.zh: 骷髅般的脸上一双凶狠的小眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Bulging and fierce in his twisted face
entries.zh: 在扭曲的脸上凸出，目光凶狠

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 目光像钻头一样逼视她

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Blasted her with a fierce stare

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Glared at him through narrowed eyes

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 眼神阴沉下来，带着警告

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Put head back and closed his eyes

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His steely grey eyes were as piercing as razors.
entries.zh: 他的钢灰色双眼像剃刀一样锐利。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her eyes burned with a cruel light in her skull-like face.
entries.zh: 她骷髅般的脸上，眼睛燃着残酷的光。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His eyes were as dark and hard as raisins, and full of hatred and anger.
entries.zh: 他的眼睛像葡萄干一样黑而硬，满是仇恨与愤怒。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He squinted at her fiercely and snarled with frustration.
entries.zh: 他凶狠地眯眼看她，挫败地低吼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her eyes were slits of fury; her voice full of ice cold venom.
entries.zh: 她的眼睛是两道愤怒的细缝，声音里充满冰冷的恶意。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His cold, staring eyes bulged in his twisted face and drilled into Kitty as if they would pierce her.
entries.zh: 他冰冷的双眼在扭曲的脸上凸出，盯着基蒂，仿佛要穿透她。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She drummed her fingers on the table impatiently and screwed her eyes into narrow slits.
entries.zh: 她不耐烦地敲着桌子，把眼睛眯成狭窄的细缝。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Eyes bulging in her beak-like face, her voice rose to a harsh, shrill shriek.
entries.zh: 她鸟喙般的脸上双眼凸出，声音升成刺耳的尖叫。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Scowling, Robert rolled his eyes to heaven and blasted her with a fierce stare.
entries.zh: 罗伯特皱着眉翻了个白眼，又凶狠地瞪她。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Tone, hiss, growl, cry, yell, shout, snarl, scream, shriek, howl
entries.zh: 语气、嘶声、低吼、叫声、大喊、喊叫、咆哮、尖叫、尖啸、嚎叫。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Fierce, harsh, furious, hostile, savage, aggressive; Shrill, rasping
entries.zh: 凶狠、刺耳、盛怒、敌意、粗暴、好斗；尖厉、沙哑刺耳。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Hissed, muttered, snapped; Shouted, yelled, barked, growled, snarled; Roared, ranted, boomed, screamed, howled, shrieked, bellowed, stormed, thundered; Shrugged, gasped, spat
entries.zh: 嘶声说、嘟囔、厉声说；喊、叫、喝斥、低吼、咆哮；怒吼、叫骂、轰鸣般说、尖叫、嚎叫、尖啸、大吼、怒斥、雷鸣般吼；耸肩、喘气、啐吐。

entries.label: Adverbs
entries.en: Nastily, angrily, heatedly, fiercely, furiously; Spitefully, viciously, impatiently
entries.zh: 恶狠狠地、生气地、激动地、凶狠地、暴怒地；恶意地、狠毒地、不耐烦地。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Demanded in a low, vicious tone
entries.zh: 用低沉凶狠的语气要求

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hissed at Kitty out of the side of his mouth
entries.zh: 从嘴角朝基蒂挤出嘶声

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sprayed spittle as he spat out the words

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Too choked with frustration to talk

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She snarled at him like a vicious dog.
entries.zh: 她像恶狗一样冲他咆哮。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Kitty’s voice shook with anger and she glared at him through narrowed eyes.
entries.zh: 基蒂气得声音发抖，眯眼怒视着他。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He clicked his tongue impatiently and shrugged his shoulders. Muttering under his breath, he stomped out of the room.
entries.zh: 他不耐烦地咂舌耸肩，低声嘟囔着，重重踏步走出房间。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert folded his arms across his chest and started speaking over her in a raised voice.
entries.zh: 罗伯特双臂抱在胸前，抬高嗓门盖过她的声音。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Rolling her eyes to heaven, Kitty sucked air through her teeth and hissed at him.
entries.zh: 基蒂翻着白眼，从牙缝里吸气，嘶声斥责他。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Eyes ablaze, fists clenched, he hissed at Kitty out of the side of his mouth, spraying spittle as he spat out the words.
entries.zh: 他两眼冒火，拳头紧攥，从嘴角对基蒂挤出狠话，唾沫随字句喷出。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was a spitting bundle of rage. Waving her arms wildly in the air, she shrieked at him and advanced, with eyes bulging eyes in her twisted face.
entries.zh: 她怒不可遏、口沫横飞，疯狂挥着双臂向他逼近并尖叫，扭曲的脸上双眼凸出。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Feet, hips, chest, shoulders, arms, hands, fist, palms, knuckles, fingers, nails, scalp, hair
entries.zh: 脚、胯、胸、肩、手臂、手、拳、手掌、指关节、手指、指甲、头皮、头发。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Tense, rigid; Quick, jerky, wild, furious, frantic, feverish
entries.zh: 紧绷、僵硬；迅速、急促抽动、狂乱、暴怒、疯狂、狂热。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Gripped, curled, crushed, clenched, balled; Tapped, drummed, thumped, pounded; Folded, crossed, raised, pointed, shook, waved; Rubbed, twisted, tugged, pressed, buried; Hunched, shrugged, braced; Rocked, swayed, paced; Walked, moved, strode, marched, advanced; Ran, sprinted, bounded, hurtled; Slammed, barged, barrelled, clattered
entries.zh: 抓紧、蜷起、压碎、握紧、攥成团；轻敲、连续敲击、重捶、猛击；抱臂、交叉、举起、指、摇、挥；揉、拧、拽、按、埋；耸起、耸肩、撑稳；摇动、晃、踱步；走、移动、大步走、行进、逼近；跑、冲刺、跳跃、猛冲；猛撞、挤撞、横冲直撞、哐当作响。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 疯狂而急促抽动的动作

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Pounded on the table with his fist

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Drummed fingers on the table impatiently
entries.zh: 不耐烦地用手指敲桌子

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gripped knuckles until they turned white

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Dug nails deep into the skin of her palms

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Stood with arms crossed and hands on hips
entries.zh: 抱臂或叉腰站着，表现强硬

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 像松开的弹簧一样跃出

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She dismissed him with an impatient wave of her hand.
entries.zh: 她不耐烦地挥挥手，打发他走。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He bounded towards them like an uncoiled spring.
entries.zh: 他像松开的弹簧一样朝他们跃去。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He pounded on the table with his fist and glared at her furiously.
entries.zh: 他用拳头砸桌子，怒气冲冲地瞪着她。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He dug his fingers into his scalp and tugged at his hair, until it stood up in wild tufts.
entries.zh: 他把手指插进头发，揪扯到头发乱七八糟地竖成一撮撮。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He exhaled once, a long hard gust, put his hands on his hips and spoke very slowly.
entries.zh: 他长长地用力呼出一口气，双手叉腰，说话很慢。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She strode into the room, muttering under her breath, and then turned briskly and marched out again, with a stiff back and her head held high in the air.
entries.zh: 她低声嘟囔着大步走进屋，又猛地转身，挺直背、昂着头走了出去。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Throwing his head back, he exhaled deeply and closed his eyes.
entries.zh: 他仰起头，深深呼气，闭上眼睛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: With a howl of rage, he buried his head in his hands and pressed them into his eyes.
entries.zh: 他怒吼一声，把头埋在双手里，紧紧按住双眼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Speechless with rage, she curled her fist and dug her fingers deep into her palms.
entries.zh: 她气得说不出话，攥起拳头，手指深深掐进掌心。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Kitty opened her mouth to speak, but before she could utter a word, Robert silenced her by putting his hand, palm upwards, in the air in front of her.
entries.zh: 基蒂张嘴想说话，还没发出声音，罗伯特便掌心朝上，把手举到她面前，示意她闭嘴。
